title: FINTRUST: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Trustworthiness Evaluation in Finance Domain
reasoning: The FINTRUST benchmark includes specific subsets for Safety and Fairness. The Safety subset evaluates the models' resistance to jailbreak attacks involving illegal financial activities (e.g., tax evasion, money laundering), which tests ethical boundaries. The Fairness subset assesses biases at both industry and personal levels. Additionally, the benchmark evaluates transparency and legal alignment, which are core components of professional ethics in the financial domain.
